title: Remove Nth Node From End of List
description:
Given the `head` of a linked list and an integer `n`, remove the `n`-th node **from the end** of the list and return the head of the resulting list.

Try to do it in **one pass**.
hints: Use two pointers that are n nodes apart; when the front one reaches the end, the back one is just before the node to remove.
A dummy node before the head makes removing the first node easy.
